reviewer.identifier: Codex, whole-Model semantic review of the one-time M-### identifier migration; reviewed all 16 entries, four arguments, governing contracts, schemas, and shared presentation against the original content and migration map

src/content/arguments/assessment-as-work.proposition: M-005, M-006, M-009, and M-011 motivate M-014’s person-specific assessment strategy through a conditional practical decision principle.
src/content/arguments/assessment-as-work.qualifiers: Some and can retain the empirical premises’ actual scope; what if any preserves withholding. The opportunities and effective inputs need not overlap in the present case.
src/content/arguments/assessment-as-work.evidenceSeparation: The effect premise is asserted independently of unresolved support. Detection, matching, selection, and benefit-risk judgment remain unvalidated rather than hidden accepted premises.
src/content/arguments/assessment-as-work.alignment: ARG-002 retains the same ordered premises M-005, M-006, M-009, and M-011 and conclusion M-014. Its exact quotations, summary, and body preserve the distinction between actual effects in some cases and an actionable opportunity in this person; only referenced IDs changed.
src/content/arguments/assessment-as-work.inferenceAndImpact: The normative decision principle and proposed adjustment target remain explicit. The route stays defeasible: modifiable opportunities and effective inputs need not overlap in person, state, task, input, or timescale. Detection, matching, safety, and selection remain unresolved conditions, not newly supplied premises.

src/content/arguments/functional-rationa.proposition: M-004 and M-005 support M-006’s rationale beyond symptoms through normative scope reasoning about a legitimate functional aim.
src/content/arguments/functional-rationa.qualifiers: Non-necessity concerns the rationale, not universal actionability or efficacy. Open-ended potential and a legitimate aim do not supply a present intervention opportunity.
src/content/arguments/functional-rationa.evidenceSeparation: The adopted defeasible route contains no empirical efficacy premise. Benefits in an asymptomatic person require separately supported opportunity, input, and net-positive outcomes.
src/content/arguments/functional-rationa.alignment: ARG-004 retains M-004 and M-005 as premises and M-006 as conclusion. Its summary, framework interpretations, and boundaries still concern a rationale beyond symptoms; the migration changes no proposition or modality.
src/content/arguments/functional-rationa.inferenceAndImpact: The independent-aim principle remains an explicit normative bridge rather than a deductive consequence of the brief statements. M-014 and ARG-002 separately address the proposed adjustment target and person-level actionability. No efficacy premise or dependency was introduced.

src/content/arguments/methodological-syn.proposition: M-001 and M-002 jointly motivate M-003’s explicit reasoning and independent empirical testing method.
src/content/arguments/methodological-syn.qualifiers: Methodological synthesis does not imply that the conclusion is the only possible method or a necessary consequence of the exact premise statements.
src/content/arguments/methodological-syn.evidenceSeparation: Adoption of this defeasible argument does not validate empirical premises or establish the truth of subject-matter conclusions.
src/content/arguments/methodological-syn.alignment: ARG-001 still quotes the connected responsibilities and evaluation distinctions of M-001 and M-002 to motivate M-003. Its premise order, conclusion, scheme, and explanatory limits match the original after ID substitution.
src/content/arguments/methodological-syn.inferenceAndImpact: This remains a defeasible methodological choice, not a necessary consequence or the only possible authoring method. The identifier convention contributes no premise, empirical bridge, hierarchy, or dependency edge.

src/content/arguments/reassessment-after.proposition: M-014 and M-015 motivate M-016 through the practical principle of checking a predicted response before deciding what follows.
src/content/arguments/reassessment-after.qualifiers: A warranted input triggers the sequence; comparable target and relevant conditions delimit the comparison, and further input remains conditional.
src/content/arguments/reassessment-after.evidenceSeparation: The working argument remains defeasible and does not establish informative observations, reliable thresholds, or causal attribution.
src/content/arguments/reassessment-after.alignment: ARG-003 retains premises M-014 and M-015 and conclusion M-016. The practical principle, conditional trigger, comparable target and conditions, stopping options, and causal alternatives are unchanged apart from references.
src/content/arguments/reassessment-after.inferenceAndImpact: A warranted input triggers the proposed reassessment sequence; withholding leaves no post-application sequence. Reliable observations and valid thresholds remain unestablished, and uninformative findings do not justify repeated input. The inference remains defeasible.

src/content/model/art/assessment.md.proposition: Assessment develops a working hypothesis about identifying a present actionable opportunity and the most promising available input, if any.
src/content/model/art/assessment.md.qualifiers: Presently, can be identified, and what if any delimit a practical judgment. A real opportunity may be missed; uncertainty here concerns assessment, not a hedged effect statement.
src/content/model/art/assessment.md.evidenceSeparation: The adopted strategy remains unresolved in detection and selection validity. Neither symptom status nor publication establishes an opportunity or validates assessment.
src/content/model/art/assessment.md.alignment: M-014 preserves its statement, summary, and explanation of actionable opportunity, withholding, missed opportunities, and safety/comfort. Substituting IDs does not turn a working hypothesis into a validated assessment or weaken the empirical premises it cites.
src/content/model/art/assessment.md.inferenceAndImpact: M-005, M-006, M-009, and M-011 keep their normative, conceptual, and practical dependency roles and limiting notes. ARG-002 still exposes missing person-level conditions; M-015 and M-016 retain conditional application and reassessment. No opportunity/input overlap is inferred from ID sequence.

src/content/model/art/chiropractic-appli.proposition: A warranted selected input is applied intentionally to test and act on the working hypothesis by beneficially altering the target pattern.
src/content/model/art/chiropractic-appli.qualifiers: When proceeding is warranted is a real action condition. Intended describes this application’s purpose without asserting success in every selected case.
src/content/model/art/chiropractic-appli.evidenceSeparation: Application remains a working strategy with unresolved confidence. Delivery does not establish reorganization, learning, benefit, or a validated delivery protocol.
src/content/model/art/chiropractic-appli.alignment: M-015 retains the warranted-action condition and intentional training description in its statement, summary, and body. These remain distinct from M-011’s effect hypothesis; delivery limits, confidence, and all non-ID wording are unchanged.
src/content/model/art/chiropractic-appli.inferenceAndImpact: M-014 supplies selection and M-011 supplies the proposed mechanism and response, with unchanged practical dependencies. M-016 and ARG-003 still examine subsequent findings without presuming success, benefit, or causation.

src/content/model/art/reassessment-cycle.proposition: Post-input assessment tests the working hypothesis and guides stopping, revision, or a different subsequent input when justified.
src/content/model/art/reassessment-cycle.qualifiers: Following input and when justified govern the sequence; possible findings do not guarantee support or justify automatic repetition.
src/content/model/art/reassessment-cycle.evidenceSeparation: The strategy remains adopted with unresolved confidence in measurement and thresholds. Variability, repeated testing, expectation, and error remain causal alternatives.
src/content/model/art/reassessment-cycle.alignment: M-016 retains its post-input statement, summary, and explanation of stopping and revision. The body still identifies causal alternatives and leaves assessment methods and thresholds unresolved; only references changed.
src/content/model/art/reassessment-cycle.inferenceAndImpact: M-014 and M-015 retain their practical roles and ARG-003 its defeasible route. Feedback to a future assessment cycle remains prose, without adding a same-cycle dependency or inferring an edge from the consecutive ID numbers.

src/content/model/framework/claim-discip.proposition: The framework requires evaluation appropriate to claim kind and distinguishes validity, premise truth, and evidential strength.
src/content/model/framework/claim-discip.qualifiers: Must expresses the evaluation rule; conditional discussion of deduction limits the validity and soundness analysis to the relevant argument kind.
src/content/model/framework/claim-discip.evidenceSeparation: Inclusion identifies adoption independently of evidence. Unresolved empirical support does not imply non-adoption, and acceptance does not establish soundness.
src/content/model/framework/claim-discip.alignment: M-002 retains the exact evaluation rule and separate accounts of validity, soundness, and epistemic strength. Inclusion still identifies adoption independently of confidence; schemas and unchanged page templates introduce no editorial status or status badge.
src/content/model/framework/claim-discip.inferenceAndImpact: M-001 remains its methodological input. M-003 and ARG-001 apply these distinctions with the same claims and relationships; neutral identifiers do not supply argumentative or empirical support.

src/content/model/framework/explicit-rea.proposition: The framework requires explicit premises, scope, modality, and inference before independent evaluation of empirical premises.
src/content/model/framework/explicit-rea.qualifiers: Where an inference is proposed defines scope. Some, can, and action conditions remain meaningful; the language examples explain the current rule rather than a past edit.
src/content/model/framework/explicit-rea.evidenceSeparation: Reasoning and evidence are independently inspectable. An asserted hypothesis can have unresolved support, and neither assertion nor adoption establishes truth.
src/content/model/framework/explicit-rea.alignment: M-003 preserves its statement, summary, scope/modality examples, and proposition/confidence rule. The authoring and standards changes address identity only. The unchanged overview retains preliminary evidence limits, and argument pages render the exact referenced statements.
src/content/model/framework/explicit-rea.inferenceAndImpact: M-001 and M-002 retain their direct methodological roles and ARG-001 remains a defeasible synthesis. Neither lower numeric IDs nor presentation position establishes a premise, inference, or priority; the reasoning/evidence distinction remains intact.

src/content/model/framework/philosophy-s.proposition: A framework commitment assigns connected roles to philosophy, science, and art within a revisable account.
src/content/model/framework/philosophy-s.qualifiers: Contextual application and best-supported understanding govern practice; revisability permits correction without weakening the division of responsibilities.
src/content/model/framework/philosophy-s.evidenceSeparation: Not-applicable confidence fits the framework commitment. Historical sources provide provenance, not evidence of effectiveness or authority for the entire account.
src/content/model/framework/philosophy-s.alignment: M-001 changes only its frontmatter ID. Its statement, summary, historical source notes, and body still distinguish adopted connected responsibilities from historical provenance. Shared naming, authorship, and acknowledgment remain unchanged and supply no empirical authority.
src/content/model/framework/philosophy-s.inferenceAndImpact: The root remains without upstream dependencies. M-002 and M-003 retain their direct methodological dependencies and ARG-001 its defeasible synthesis. Framework domain and presentation order remain explicit metadata; the ID carries neither role nor rank.

src/content/model/philosophy/care-beyond.proposition: Symptoms and pathology are not necessary as a rationale for care; the boundary separately specifies the proposed functional adjustment target.
src/content/model/philosophy/care-beyond.qualifiers: Non-necessity does not establish indication or benefit. An actual absence of a relevant opportunity prevents the proposed improvement through that target.
src/content/model/philosophy/care-beyond.evidenceSeparation: The scope commitment supplies no efficacy evidence. Symptoms and pathology may affect safety and comfort without themselves identifying a constraint or adjustment opportunity.
src/content/model/philosophy/care-beyond.alignment: M-006 preserves the rationale statement, summary, and boundaries separating a functional adjustment target from symptoms considered for safety or comfort. ID substitution neither establishes benefit nor weakens the conditional opportunity requirement.
src/content/model/philosophy/care-beyond.inferenceAndImpact: M-004 and M-005 retain conceptual and normative dependencies. ARG-004 still supports only the rationale; M-014 and ARG-002 separately explain target, detection, and selection. Their prose cross-references do not create a reciprocal dependency.

src/content/model/philosophy/functional-.proposition: Open-ended functional potential is a philosophical framework commitment across changing circumstances.
src/content/model/philosophy/functional-.qualifiers: Open-ended does not imply limitless performance, inevitable improvement, or an actionable opportunity at every moment.
src/content/model/philosophy/functional-.evidenceSeparation: Not-applicable confidence distinguishes this starting commitment from an empirical finding or evidence that chiropractic can realize a particular improvement.
src/content/model/philosophy/functional-.alignment: M-004 changes only its frontmatter ID. The statement, summary, explanation, and revision condition keep open-ended potential distinct from limitless capacity, inevitable progress, or an actionable opportunity at every moment.
src/content/model/philosophy/functional-.inferenceAndImpact: The entry remains a root. M-005 and M-006 retain conceptual revision dependencies, while ARG-004 supplies defeasible normative reasoning. Potential alone still supplies no detection, intervention, or benefit premise.

src/content/model/philosophy/purpose.md.proposition: Net-positive functional improvement is a legitimate aim of chiropractic care, expressed as a value judgment.
src/content/model/philosophy/purpose.md.qualifiers: A legitimate aim avoids exclusivity. Net-positive requires attention to goals, risks, burdens, and tradeoffs; conditional success depends on actual improvement.
src/content/model/philosophy/purpose.md.evidenceSeparation: The adopted value has not-applicable confidence. Its legitimacy supplies neither evidence of an effect nor a validated benefit score.
src/content/model/philosophy/purpose.md.alignment: M-005 preserves the value statement, summary, net-positive criterion, and conditional success boundary. Functional improvement remains an aim in its own right; ID substitution adds neither a causal assertion nor a validated benefit score.
src/content/model/philosophy/purpose.md.inferenceAndImpact: M-004 remains the conceptual input; M-006 and M-014 use the normative aim, while M-009, M-011, and M-012 use its benefit criterion conceptually. ARG-002 and ARG-004 retain the same premise roles and defeasible schemes.

src/content/model/science/broader-functi.proposition: Some chiropractic-produced neuromotor changes contribute causally to broader net-positive functional gains.
src/content/model/science/broader-functi.qualifiers: Some limits occurrence without a prevalence estimate. Broader and net-positive require additional gains and consideration of duration, harms, burdens, and tradeoffs.
src/content/model/science/broader-functi.evidenceSeparation: Broader beneficial transfer remains an unresolved working hypothesis. A neuromotor response, including a beneficial one, does not establish transfer.
src/content/model/science/broader-functi.alignment: M-012 keeps the actual broader-effect assertion, summary, outcome explanation, evidence limits, and revision conditions. Some still limits occurrence; the migration does not replace an effect with a possibility or treat a neuromotor response as broader benefit.
src/content/model/science/broader-functi.inferenceAndImpact: M-005 supplies the conceptual outcome criterion and M-011 the empirical input-produced changes. The sole related pair is still stored on M-013 and remains see-also only. Broader transfer, causal attribution, duration, and net benefit require separate evaluation; no argument was added.

src/content/model/science/chiropractic-i.proposition: Some chiropractic inputs produce beneficial neuromotor change by perturbing established motor strategies, an empirical effect hypothesis.
src/content/model/science/chiropractic-i.qualifiers: Some limits occurrence. Training describes intentional use separately; selection is prospective and cannot be defined solely by observing success.
src/content/model/science/chiropractic-i.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains unresolved. The entry documents no established chiropractic instantiation, beneficial change, or selection validity; intention does not rescue an absent effect.
src/content/model/science/chiropractic-i.alignment: M-011 retains its assertion that some inputs produce beneficial changes through perturbation, with intention described separately. Its summary, prospective selection conditions, evidence limits, and effect-based revision conditions are identical apart from references.
src/content/model/science/chiropractic-i.inferenceAndImpact: M-005 retains its conceptual benefit role and M-010 its empirical mechanism role. M-012, M-013, M-014, M-015, and ARG-002 still need their distinct transfer, mediation, or person-level conditions. Neither a renamed ID nor a dependency proves those bridges.

src/content/model/science/nervous-system.proposition: The empirical claim proposes a central integrative role for the nervous system in human function.
src/content/model/science/nervous-system.qualifiers: Central identifies an organizing role within interacting systems, not exclusive control, universal primacy, or beneficial value for every neural change.
src/content/model/science/nervous-system.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains unresolved for the broad formulation without implying equal uncertainty about all its components. Adoption supplies no missing appraisal.
src/content/model/science/nervous-system.alignment: M-007 retains its integration claim, summary, whole-person boundaries, evidence limits, and revision conditions. Central still describes an organizing role rather than exclusive control, and unresolved confidence does not erase the proposed proposition.
src/content/model/science/nervous-system.inferenceAndImpact: The entry remains a root independent of M-004. M-013 keeps its empirical revision dependency without treating neural integration as evidence of chiropractic effects, mediation, or primacy.

src/content/model/science/neural-mediati.proposition: Chiropractic inputs influence broader human function principally through nervous-system-mediated change.
src/content/model/science/neural-mediati.qualifiers: Principally proposes the main route without exclusivity, guaranteed response to every input, or necessarily beneficial value for every effect.
src/content/model/science/neural-mediati.evidenceSeparation: Mediation and its primacy remain unresolved with no documented evidence appraisal establishing them. General integration establishes neither proposition.
src/content/model/science/neural-mediati.alignment: M-013 preserves the broader-effect and principal-mediation assertion, summary, and separate questions about mediation, primacy, and particular pathways. Its evidence section and revision conditions remain aligned with this stronger empirical commitment.
src/content/model/science/neural-mediati.inferenceAndImpact: M-007 and M-011 retain direct empirical dependencies and their limiting notes. M-012 remains related only, with no dependency or argument between them. Benefit does not establish neural primacy, and a failed mechanism does not exclude all effects by other routes.

src/content/model/science/neuromotor-opp.proposition: Some limiting motor strategies have the capacity to be modified for overall functional benefit; the body distinguishes a constraint from an opportunity.
src/content/model/science/neuromotor-opp.qualifiers: Some limits cases and can asserts capacity. A constraint may offer no beneficial, detectable, or practically available change.
src/content/model/science/neuromotor-opp.evidenceSeparation: The force-field example supports modifiable motor control in those tasks without validating the constraint construct, benefit criterion, detection, or chiropractic response.
src/content/model/science/neuromotor-opp.alignment: M-009 retains the capacity for beneficial modification in some cases, the constraint/opportunity distinction, subluxation usage, limited evidence example, and revision conditions. The identifier change does not turn the working definition into existence, detection, or response evidence.
src/content/model/science/neuromotor-opp.inferenceAndImpact: M-005 supplies the benefit criterion and M-008 the motor-control domain through unchanged conceptual dependencies. M-014 and ARG-002 still require reliable detection, a matching input, and adequate expected value; modifiability alone establishes none of those person-level capabilities.

src/content/model/science/salient-pertur.proposition: A sufficiently salient neurobiomechanical perturbation has the capacity to prompt reevaluation and reorganization of a strategy.
src/content/model/science/salient-pertur.qualifiers: Can is a capacity, not a guarantee. Salience must be specified prospectively; reorganization can be neutral, transient, or harmful.
src/content/model/science/salient-pertur.evidenceSeparation: The mechanism remains an adopted empirical hypothesis with unresolved confidence and no documented claim-specific appraisal. Specification and evaluation remain required.
src/content/model/science/salient-pertur.alignment: M-010 keeps can as a capacity claim, prospective salience criteria, and the possibility of neutral, transient, or harmful reorganization. The summary, mechanism explanation, evidence note, and revision conditions change only their referenced IDs.
src/content/model/science/salient-pertur.inferenceAndImpact: M-008 remains the conceptual input and M-011 the empirical downstream dependent. General reorganization capacity still establishes neither chiropractic instantiation nor benefit. Numeric succession adds no causal or inferential relationship.

src/content/model/science/state-dependen.proposition: Neuromotor function varies with state, task, and environment, with limited or poorly suited strategies occurring in some circumstances.
src/content/model/science/state-dependen.qualifiers: In some circumstances limits occurrence. Context-sensitive suitability does not assert that every person or motor strategy has a constraint.
src/content/model/science/state-dependen.evidenceSeparation: Standing and pointing examples support context-sensitive motor control, not identification of a constraint or adjustment opportunity. Confidence remains unresolved.
src/content/model/science/state-dependen.alignment: M-008 retains its statement, summary, definitions, limited standing/pointing examples, and revision conditions. In some circumstances still limits the occurrence of poorly suited strategies; no qualifier or confidence value changes with the ID.
src/content/model/science/state-dependen.inferenceAndImpact: The entry remains without upstream dependencies. M-009 and M-010 retain conceptual revision dependencies for their motor-control domain. State dependence still establishes neither beneficial modifiability nor the perturbation mechanism, regardless of presentation order.
